activity_summary: At the bridge foot Henslowe was counting, and he knew you. He asked whether the wit pays. You said by the share. He pays by the play, six pound, and he never argues the jig. You took the bridge toward home, and you did not tell him what you had come to.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said he is paid by the share, and took the bridge toward home.

entities.name: Philip Henslowe
entities.context: Knew him, asked whether wit pays, and named six pound and the jig.

facets.activity: Told Henslowe the pay is by the share

quotes.speaker: philip_henslowe
quotes.text: You've a pretty wit, Master Shakespeare. Does it pay?

quotes.speaker: philip_henslowe
quotes.text: Ah. I pay by the play. Six pound, and I never argue the jig.
